# stapel-cms 0.1.0

Public site content for a Stapel product: pages in a slug tree, a blog (posts, tags, date and tag archives, RSS/Atom), menus (header/footer trees targeting pages, posts, URLs or named frontend routes), SEO fields and a sitemap Function, and redirects written automatically when a published page or post moves. Bodies are typed block lists (rich_text as a ProseMirror/TipTap JSON document, hero, faq, gallery, embed with a host allowlist, a stapel-forms form by id, an opaque listing_rail query) validated by pydantic models from a MERGE registry, so a project adds its own block without forking. Staff write drafts, preview them by a signed link, publish now or on a schedule, keep editing while the published snapshot serves, restore revisions and archive; every publication is a fact. Content is site-scoped through the stapel-core site registry and locale-scoped with a fallback chain; a page can be copied into another locale, optionally through a machine-translation Function. The anonymous read is cached per site and answers conditional requests (ETag, Last-Modified). Not stapel-docs: docs is private workspace documents; cms is what an anonymous visitor reads at a URL of the site.

Contract: axes 2 · surface 10 · extension points 9 · operations 41 · error codes 68 · flows 4.
Generated from docs/capabilities.json by `stapel-llms-txt` — do not edit; drift-gated by `make contract-check`.

## Configuration axes — what a product switches on
Settings keys; `default` is what you get by saying nothing. Turning an axis off unmounts the operations it gates.
- BLOG_ENABLED [bool, default true] — Blog
  true (default): the site has a blog — posts, tags, monthly and tag archives, an RSS/Atom feed. false: pages, menus and redirects only. Values: true, false.
  gates 19 operation(s)
- STAFF_AUTHZ [enum, default "staff"] — Who may edit the site
  staff (default): every staff account may edit pages, posts and menus. model_perms: a staff account also needs the per-model permission its role grants (the @access mandate), e.g. to let marketing edit posts but not legal pages' menus. Values: staff, model_perms.

## Usage surface — call these before writing your own
This is the answer to "does Stapel already have something for X?". `instead of` names the outside symbol this one displaces.
### gate_function
- validate_blocks — stapel_cms.blocks.validate_blocks
  Validate a block list ({type, id, data}) and return its normalised JSON; raises BlockError with the error key. The staff API runs every save through it.
### predicate
- block_model — stapel_cms.blocks.block_model
  The pydantic model of one block type; KeyError when it is not registered.
- block_type_schemas — stapel_cms.blocks.block_type_schemas
  [{type, schema}] for every registered block type — what GET staff/block-types/ serves to the editor.
- get_block_types — stapel_cms.blocks.get_block_types
  The effective block registry (built-ins <- settings <- runtime). Ask it instead of reading the setting.
- iter_text — stapel_cms.blocks.iter_text
  Every human-text string inside blocks (headings, labels, text nodes, alt), skipping URLs, media refs and opaque queries: the word count and the translation batch read this.
- media_refs — stapel_cms.blocks.media_refs
  Every cdn media reference used inside blocks.
- word_count — stapel_cms.blocks.word_count
  Words in the human text of a block list (reading time).
### factory
- map_text — stapel_cms.blocks.map_text
  A copy of blocks with every human-text string replaced by fn(text) — how a machine translation is applied without touching URLs or ids.
- register_block_type — stapel_cms.blocks.register_block_type
  Add a project's own block type (a pydantic model) from an AppConfig.ready(), or remove a built-in with None. The settings dict STAPEL_CMS['BLOCK_TYPES'] is the other door; both merge over the built-ins.
- reset_block_types — stapel_cms.blocks.reset_block_types
  Drop runtime block registrations, leaving settings untouched — a test lever.

## Extension points — what a product replaces, fork-free
- BLOCK_TYPES [merge_registry]
  Block types a page or post body may contain: {'<type>': 'dotted.path.PydanticModel' | None} merged over the built-ins (rich_text, hero, faq, gallery, embed, form, listing_rail); None removes a built-in. A project's own block is a pydantic model (stapel_cms.blocks.BlockData, extra='forbid'); its JSON schema reaches the staff editor through GET staff/block-types/.
- EMBED_HOSTS [setting]
  Hosts an embed block may point at (exact host, https only). Replace the list to allow another provider.
- MACHINE_TRANSLATE [strategy]
  Name of a comm Function {texts, source, target} -> {texts} used when staff copy a page into another locale with machine_translate. Empty = off; unreachable or malformed answers are a 503, never an untranslated copy.
- MEDIA_REFS_FUNCTION [strategy]
  comm Function that tracks which media content uses (default cdn.refs_sync); empty disables. Best-effort after commit.
- STAPEL_CMS_PUBLIC_PRESENTER / STAPEL_CMS_STAFF_PRESENTER [presenter]
  Swap keys (STAPEL_SWAP) for the public and staff presenters, so a host changes what the API shows without forking a view.
- cms.page.published [comm_event]
  A page snapshot went live (now or at its scheduled time): site, locale, path, revision, translation group. CDN purge, search indexing and sitemap pings subscribe.
- cms.post.published [comm_event]
  A blog post went live: path, tags, the staff author id.
- cms.redirect.created [comm_event]
  A published page or post moved (or staff added a redirect): old_path -> new_path.
- cms.sitemap_entries [comm_function]
  Published, indexable pages and posts of a site with hreflang alternates, keyset-paged: what a sitemap aggregator asks.

## Fits with — fleet dependencies
- stapel-cdn (optional) — media references are cdn refs (<type>/<id>); cdn.refs_sync keeps pictures used by content from being swept as unclaimed
- stapel-core (required) — comm bus (cms.* facts, sitemap/resolve/feed Functions, user.merged consumer), site registry, AnchorPagination, GDPR owner protocol, @access, AppSettings
- stapel-forms (optional) — the form block embeds a stapel-forms form by its public_id
- stapel-translate (optional) — a content translation Function behind MACHINE_TRANSLATE copies a page into another locale machine-translated (upstream ask T1)

## HTTP operations (41) — call by operationId, never by a typed path
Paths are relative to `/cms/api/v1/`.
### CMS public
- GET /public/feed/ — cms_public_feed
- GET /public/menus/{key}/ — cms_public_menus_retrieve
- GET /public/post-archive/ — cms_public_post_archive
- GET /public/posts/ — cms_public_posts_list
- GET /public/posts/{slug}/ — cms_public_posts_retrieve
- GET /public/preview/ — cms_public_preview
- GET /public/resolve/ — cms_public_resolve
- GET /public/tags/ — cms_public_tags_list
### CMS staff

## Documented flows (4) — full steps in docs/flows.json
- cms.author — Write and publish content
- cms.blog — Read the blog
- cms.read — Read the site's pages
- cms.site — Arrange the site
